guard: history drain rejects SPEC §5 mismatches and fail-closes on shape; surviving DMs take recipient from the subject; god-view keeps the viewer's own send
why: SPEC §5: mismatch / missing from / unparseable subject MUST be rejected, never rewritten.
A stored JSON null used to throw TypeError mid-page and drop honest rows (regression vs HEAD^).
God-view must include a DM the viewer itself sent; a comment is not a test.
Matching from.id still rewrites recipient from the subject so thread injection cannot land.

mutations.name: history drain returns the payload and discards SPEC §5
mutations.expectRed: spoofed payload is ABSENT from history (SPEC §5 reject, not rewrite)
mutations.cell: spoofed payload is ABSENT from history (SPEC §5 reject, not rewrite)

mutations.name: authenticatedMessage skips DM recipient rewrite

mutations.cell: matching from.id still rewrites recipient from the subject, not payload to

mutations.name: history echo-drops the viewer's own send
mutations.find:
if (raw.from.id !== parsed.sender) return undefined;
  return authenticatedMessage(raw as CotalMessage, parsed);

mutations.cell: history still includes a DM the viewer itself sent
